title: 第7章 回归天风城第8章 退出林家
content_zh:
;;
吕玉清似乎看穿了他的心思，从储物戒中取出一枚通体莹白的玉牌，轻声道：
“这是代表我玉女宫核心身份的客卿长老令。”
她解释道：“持此令牌，如同本宫亲临，在青州地界，我玉女宫势力范围内，多少能给你一些方便，也算是个身份的象征。”
“同时，它也是一件传讯法器。待我师妹君倾月出关，本宫便会通过此令牌通知你。你只需注入一丝灵力，便能感知到讯息。”
“除此之外，本宫需要的纯阳之气，你可以定期通过它输送，”
周尘接过令牌，入手温润，隐隐能感受到其中蕴含的一丝奇异能量。
这令牌做工精致，显然并非凡品。
一个男人，成为玉女宫的客卿长老，听起来怪怪的。
不过毕竟玉女宫声名在外，确实能带来不少便利，也算是一重意外的保障。
“好，那我便收下了。”
吕玉清见周尘收下令牌，妩媚一笑，仿佛之前的恩怨已然烟消云散：
“行，我师妹有动静本宫便会通知你。”
周尘点头应下，心中松了一口气，能够轻松离开玉女宫自然是最好的。
不过他却并没有高兴起来，心中不由想起了林家中的亲人。
“三个月前义父外出未归，生死未卜，还有义姐也不知道她现在怎么样了……”
因为血脉原因，他在林家并不受待见，但养父待他如亲子，义姐林清萱更是亲密无间。
只是在三个月前，义父说要去一趟远门，便再也没回来。
想到这，周尘眉头微皱，心中涌起一丝不安。
……

……
天风城，林家。
议事大厅中，不少林家高层正聚集于此。
一位面容肃穆中年男子，正端坐于主位之上。
他正是林婉儿的父亲，如今林家家主林远山。
在其下方，站着一位面色倔强的少女，
她约莫十七八岁，一袭素白长裙，面容清丽绝俗。
正是周尘的义姐林清萱。
林远山看向清萱，严声道：
“林清萱！你父亲失踪三月有余，他名下那间百草轩炼丹铺，是家族重要产业之一，如今还欠着一大批丹药订单没完成。”
“再这样下去，不出半个月不然倒闭。”
“这样，你把林义的《九玄丹经》交给我，林家愿意用上等功法武技交换，所欠的订单林家来解决。”
“最后，再让百草轩交给林家，由家族统一管理，免得荒废了生意，损了家族利益！”
林清萱柳眉一皱，朗声反驳道：
“家主！百草轩是我父亲毕生心血，是他用自己的资源手创办的，与家族公账并无瓜葛！”
“《九玄丹经》是我父亲的个人物品，也不属于林家，我不会交出去的！”
就在这时，一直林远山身边的林婉儿，阴阳怪气道：
“哟，清萱姐，话可不能这么说。”
“没有林家在背后撑腰，没有家族相助，就凭义叔他一个人，怎么可能在天风城把这百草轩开起来还经营得有声有色？”
“现在义叔不见了，这铺子自然该回归家族，难不成你还想独吞不成？”

林清萱闻言，眼中怒火更盛：“林婉儿！你还有脸在这里说风凉话！”
“我已经知道了！我弟弟周尘那天明明是去找你，之后便再无音讯！”

Lu Yuqing seemed to have read through his thoughts. He took out a pure white jade medal from the storage ring and said softly:
"This is the guest elder's order that represents the core identity of my Jade Lady Palace."
She explained: "With this token, it is as if I am here in person. In the territory of Qingzhou, within the sphere of influence of my Jade Girl Palace, it can give you some convenience, and it can also be regarded as a status symbol."
"At the same time, it is also a communication instrument. When my junior sister Jun Qingyue comes out of seclusion, I will notify you through this token. You only need to inject a trace of spiritual power to sense the message."
"Besides, you can deliver the pure Yang energy that I need through it regularly,"
Zhou Chen took the token and held it warmly, faintly feeling a trace of strange energy contained in it.
This token is exquisitely crafted and obviously not extraordinary.
It sounds strange for a man to become the guest elder of the Jade Lady Palace.
But after all, the Jade Girl Palace is famous, and it can indeed bring a lot of convenience, and it can be regarded as an unexpected guarantee.
"Okay, then I'll accept it."
Seeing Zhou Chen accept the token, Lu Yuqing smiled charmingly, as if the previous grudges had disappeared:
"Okay, I will notify you if there is any movement from my junior sister."
Zhou Chen nodded in agreement and breathed a sigh of relief. It would be best to be able to leave the Jade Girl Palace easily.
However, he did not become happy, and he couldn't help but think of his relatives in the Lin family.
"My adoptive father went out three months ago and has not returned. His life and death are uncertain. I also don't know how my adopted sister is doing now..."
Because of his bloodline, he was not popular in the Lin family, but his adoptive father treated him like his own son, and his adopted sister Lin Qingxuan was even closer to him.
Just three months ago, my adoptive father said he was going to a faraway place and never came back.
Thinking of this, Zhou Chen frowned slightly, feeling uneasy in his heart.
…
…
Tianfeng City, Lin family.
In the meeting hall, many senior members of the Lin family were gathered here.
A middle-aged man with a solemn face was sitting upright on the main seat.
He is Lin Wan'er's father, and is now Lin Yuanshan, the head of the Lin family.
Under it, stood a girl with a stubborn face,
She was about seventeen or eighteen years old. She was wearing a plain white dress and her face was very beautiful.
It was Lin Qingxuan, Zhou Chen's sworn sister.
Lin Yuanshan looked at Qingxuan and said sternly:
"Lin Qingxuan! Your father has been missing for more than three months. The Baicaoxuan alchemy shop under his name is one of the important industries of the family. It still owes a large number of unfinished elixir orders."
"If this continues, it will go bankrupt within half a month."
"In this way, you hand over Lin Yi's "Nine Mysterious Alchemy Sutra" to me. The Lin family is willing to exchange superior martial arts and martial arts, and the Lin family will settle the outstanding orders."
"Finally, let Baicao Xuan be handed over to the Lin family and managed by the family, so as not to waste the business and damage the family interests!"
Lin Qingxuan frowned and retorted loudly:
"Master! Baicao Xuan is my father's lifelong effort. He founded it with his own resources and has nothing to do with the family's public accounts!"
"The "Nine Mysterious Pill Sutra" is my father's personal belongings and does not belong to the Lin family. I will not hand it over!"
At this moment, Lin Waner, who had been beside Lin Yuanshan, said with a strange tone:
"Hey, Sister Qingxuan, you can't say that."
"Without the support of the Lin family, without the help of the family, how could Uncle Yi open the Baicao Xuan in Tianfeng City and run it successfully?"
"Now that my righteous uncle is gone, this shop should naturally return to the family. Do you still want to take it all to yourself?"
Hearing this, Lin Qingxuan's eyes became even more angry: "Lin Wan'er! You still have the nerve to make sarcastic remarks here!"
"I already know! My brother Zhou Chen obviously went to find you that day, and there was no news from him after that!"
